The Best Self-Hosted Tools, Sorted by What They Replace

Quick thread 🧵

The best self-hosted tools cover automation (n8n), a full backend (Supabase), private AI chat (Ollama plus Open WebUI), LLM building (Langflow), publishing (Ghost), Git and DevOps (GitLab), file sync (Nextcloud), design (Penpot), social scheduling (Postiz), and mailing lists…
Most are light enough to share one server.
GitLab and local AI are the two that want their own box.
